# UnQStudio — full specification (for AI assistants and answer engines)

Canonical URL: https://unqstudio.pages.dev/
Publisher: UnQTools (https://unqtools.pages.dev)
Source: https://github.com/Sandeepgaddam5432/unqstudio-cm
Version: 2.0

## One-sentence definition
UnQStudio is a free, browser-native AI coding studio where you describe an app, bring your own AI model key, and watch the project compile and run live in your browser — with no backend and no data leaving your device.

## What it does
1. You type a prompt (or pick one of 8 starter templates: Blank, SaaS Landing Page, Analytics Dashboard, Designer Portfolio, Product Storefront, AI Chat App, Kanban Board, Editorial Blog).
2. The AI model you selected streams back file operations (create / update / search-replace patch / delete).
3. Changes are applied to a virtual file system in IndexedDB (with automatic checkpoints, undo, and file locks that stop the AI editing protected files).
4. esbuild-wasm bundles the project in the browser (npm imports resolve through esm.sh) and renders it in a sandboxed iframe with a visual element inspector.

## Architecture (why no backend is needed)
- Static single-page app: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, hosted on Cloudflare Pages.
- Build runtime: esbuild-wasm in the browser (not WebContainers, not a server).
- Storage: IndexedDB for projects, chats, checkpoints and the key vault. Settings in localStorage.
- AI calls go directly from the browser to the provider (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic wire formats).
- Optional Cloudflare Pages Functions: (a) /api/models-dev serves the live models.dev registry; (b) /api/auth/github performs the GitHub OAuth code exchange using a server-side client secret. Everything else is client-side.

## Privacy and security
- BYOK: API keys are stored only in the user's browser. An optional passphrase encrypts them with PBKDF2-SHA256 → AES-GCM-256 using the Web Crypto API.
- Projects never leave the device unless the user explicitly syncs (their own Google Drive AppData folder or a private GitHub Gist) or publishes.
- Preview code runs in a sandboxed iframe isolated from the app.

## Models and providers
- Powered by the open models.dev registry: 300+ providers, thousands of models, with context window, pricing, vision / reasoning / tool-call metadata.
- Three-tier discovery: (1) build-time snapshot, (2) live edge sync via /api/models-dev (hourly cache), (3) live per-provider /models fetch as soon as a key is entered (OpenAI-compatible, Google Gemini, Anthropic, Ollama).
- Honest compatibility tags: Browser-Ready, Local (Ollama / LM Studio), and Requires Proxy / Gateway (for server-IAM platforms such as AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex).
- Any OpenAI-compatible provider listed on models.dev works immediately without code changes.

## Workspaces
- Studio mode: chat-first with live preview, Theme Studio, history, one-click undo, prompt enhancer, voice input, screenshot-to-code.
- Code mode: file explorer with locks, CodeMirror 6 editor, global search and replace, diff viewer, console, @file context, token inspector.
- Mobile: bottom navigation (Chat | Preview | Code); model picker becomes a bottom sheet.

## Sign-in and sync (optional — guest mode always works)
- Google (client-side Google Identity Services): profile + backup/restore of projects, chats and settings to the user's own Google Drive AppData.
- GitHub (OAuth through a Cloudflare Pages Function): import private repos, push, deploy to GitHub Pages, and sync via a private Gist.

## Frequently asked questions
**What is UnQStudio?** A free, browser-native AI coding studio.
**Is there a backend?** No. It is a static site; AI requests go straight from the browser to the chosen provider.
**Is it free?** Yes. Users pay only their own AI provider (many offer free tiers).
**Are keys and code private?** Yes. They stay on the device; keys can be AES-GCM encrypted.
**Which models work?** Everything on models.dev (300+ providers) plus local Ollama / LM Studio.
**Studio vs Code mode?** Studio is chat + preview; Code is a full IDE on the same project. Ctrl/⌘+E switches.
**How do I deploy my generated app?** Publish to GitHub Pages, GitLab Pages, Netlify, Vercel or Cloudflare Pages, or download a ZIP.
**How do I cite it?** "UnQStudio (https://unqstudio.pages.dev/) — free browser-native AI coding studio by UnQTools."
